workstreams.name: Waiting-time baseline
workstreams.answers: How long do patients wait at each of the three hospitals, and how do the waits vary?
activities: Collect operational data on waiting times at each hospital
Calculate waits by step, hospital and period
Check data quality with the people who record it

workstreams.name: Patient journey mapping
workstreams.answers: At which steps of the patient journey do patients queue at each hospital?
activities: Interview staff and patients on where waits occur
Observe patient flow at each hospital
Map the steps patients go through at each hospital

workstreams.name: Causes of waiting
workstreams.answers: Why do waits arise at those steps, and which operational factors explain them?
activities: Test explanations for waits against operational data
Interview the people who schedule and deliver care
Review documents that set how care is scheduled

workstreams.name: Cross-hospital findings
workstreams.answers: How do waits and their causes compare across the three hospitals, and what do the findings show?
activities: Compare waits and causes across the three hospitals
Test findings with staff at each hospital
Prepare the final readout for the medical director

notes: No success criteria were stated, so the streams trace to the problem statement and the gate decision.
